meta.name: orchestrate
meta.description: Wire Commands, Agents, and Skills together for complex features. Use when building features that need research, planning, and implementation phases.

copy.tagline: 编排命令、智能体和技能，构建多阶段复杂功能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要将多个工具和智能体组合成自动化工作流
copy.tagline_en: Wire commands, agents, and skills to build multi-step features
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to combine multiple tools and agents into automated workflows

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会按照研究、计划、实施、审查四个阶段来开发复杂功能。每个阶段都有验证关卡，例如研究阶段需评估信心分数，计划阶段需等待用户批准。
howto.when: 当用户要求开发一个涉及多个文件、需要架构决策或需求不清晰的功能时触发。

say.text: 帮我开发一个用户登录功能，涉及多个文件。
say.note: Claude 会启动多阶段流程，先研究代码库。

say.text: 我需要添加跨模块的日志记录功能。
say.note: Claude 会先做研究，然后给出计划等待批准。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will develop complex features through four phases: research, plan, implement, and review. Each phase has validation gates, e.g., research scores confidence, plan waits for approval.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to build a feature that touches multiple files, requires architectural decisions, or has unclear requirements.

say_en.text: Help me develop a user login feature involving multiple files.
say_en.note: Claude will start the multi-phase process, beginning with research.

say_en.text: I need to add cross-module logging functionality.
say_en.note: Claude will research first, then present a plan for approval.
